Cases.Title: Employment Discrimination Case – PTSD Disclosure
Cases.Description: Former sergeant facing discrimination from a civilian employer after disclosing PTSD diagnosis. Seeking support with an employment tribunal.
ToDos: Request and review employment contract and HR correspondence
Draft initial tribunal claim (ET1 form)
Arrange mental health assessment for evidence
Schedule prep call with client before preliminary hearing

Cases.Title: Ill-Health Pension Appeal – Partial Award Dispute
Cases.Description: Former police officer disputing the decision to award only a partial ill-health pension after medical retirement.
ToDos: Request copy of medical board decision from pension authority
Contact occupational health for supporting documents
Draft appeal letter to pension provider
Submit SAR (Subject Access Request) to force HR

Cases.Title: Eviction Risk Due to Benefit Delay – RAF Veteran
Cases.Description: RAF veteran facing eviction from council housing following a benefits delay. Needs emergency legal advice and representation at hearing.
ToDos: Request adjournment from court to allow time for legal aid
Contact housing officer to confirm arrears amount
Apply for backdated housing benefit
Prepare defence statement for eviction hearing

Cases.Title: Domestic Allegation Representation – Firefighter Veteran
Cases.Description: Firefighter veteran seeking representation following an arrest over an alleged domestic incident. No charges filed yet. Requires legal advocacy and support with professional body.
ToDos: Obtain custody record and police report
Arrange initial client interview to gather account
Review Fire Service disciplinary code and policies
Draft letter to professional body requesting case delay

Cases.Title: Spousal Visa Legal Support – Veteran Application
Cases.Description: Veteran supporting an application for spousal visa for partner residing overseas. Needs legal assistance with Home Office documentation and appeals process.
ToDos: Verify financial eligibility under Appendix FM
Request certified English translations of marriage documents
Complete and submit Form IAFT-6 for appeal
Contact barrister for tribunal representation options

Cases.Title: War Pension Appeal – Service-Related Injury Claim
Cases.Description: Army veteran appealing rejection of war pension claim for hearing loss and tinnitus sustained during active service in Afghanistan.
ToDos: Obtain complete military medical records from MoD
Arrange independent audiological assessment
Draft grounds of appeal to Veterans UK
Gather witness statements from former unit members

Cases.Title: Medical Negligence – Military Hospital Treatment
Cases.Description: Former major pursuing medical negligence claim against military hospital for delayed diagnosis of cancer during routine screening.
ToDos: Request full medical records from Defence Medical Services
Instruct independent medical expert for opinion
Calculate loss of earnings and future care costs
Issue Letter of Claim under Pre-Action Protocol

Cases.Title: Police Pension Forfeiture Challenge
Cases.Description: Retired police constable challenging forfeiture of pension following misconduct conviction. Seeking restoration of pension rights.
ToDos: Review disciplinary hearing transcripts and evidence
Research precedent cases on pension forfeiture
Draft application to Police Pension Appeal Tribunal
Prepare character references and mitigation evidence

Cases.Title: Service Accommodation Dispute – Unfair Eviction
Cases.Description: Navy lieutenant facing eviction from service family accommodation following medical discharge. Challenging notice period and alternative housing provision.
ToDos: Review Service Family Accommodation policy documents
Challenge medical discharge categorisation
Apply for extended notice period on medical grounds
Contact local authority for priority housing registration

Cases.Title: Criminal Injuries Compensation – Military Assault
Cases.Description: Former sergeant seeking criminal injuries compensation for assault by fellow service member during deployment. PTSD and ongoing treatment required.
ToDos: Submit CICA application within time limits
Gather military police investigation reports
Arrange psychiatric assessment for trauma evaluation
Calculate special expenses and loss of earnings

Cases.Title: Armed Forces Covenant Housing Application
Cases.Description: Royal Navy veteran seeking priority housing under Armed Forces Covenant after relationship breakdown. Currently homeless with dependent children.
ToDos: Submit homelessness application to local authority
Provide evidence of military service and discharge
Challenge any decision not to provide temporary accommodation
Apply for school places and child benefit transfers

Cases.Title: Disability Discrimination – Reasonable Adjustments
Cases.Description: Army corporal with service-related mobility issues facing discrimination from employer who refuses to make reasonable workplace adjustments.
ToDos: Document all requests for adjustments and employer responses
Obtain occupational health assessment recommendations
Draft early conciliation notification to ACAS
Prepare witness statements from colleagues

Cases.Title: Police Injury Pension Review Appeal
Cases.Description: Retired police inspector appealing reduction in injury pension following medical review. Arguing deterioration in condition since original award.
ToDos: Request all medical evidence from pension authority
Arrange independent medical examination
Review original injury pension decision and medical board notes
Prepare submission to Police Medical Appeal Board

Cases.Title: Military Covenant Childcare Dispute
Cases.Description: Navy commander seeking enforcement of childcare support commitments under Military Covenant following deployment-related family breakdown.
ToDos: Review Military Covenant provisions on family support
Document impact of deployment on family circumstances
Challenge withdrawal of childcare assistance
Apply for judicial review if internal appeals fail

Cases.Title: Court Martial Appeal – Wrongful Dismissal
Cases.Description: Army captain appealing court martial conviction and dismissal from service. Claims procedural irregularities and inadequate legal representation during original proceedings.
ToDos: Review complete court martial transcript and evidence bundle
Identify procedural errors and grounds for appeal
Instruct specialist military law counsel
Prepare application to Court Martial Appeal Court
Gather character witnesses and service record evidence

Cases.Title: Historical Sexual Abuse Compensation Claim
Cases.Description: Former police constable pursuing compensation claim for historical sexual abuse suffered during training college. Seeking damages for psychological trauma and career impact.
ToDos: Submit claim within limitation period extensions
Gather contemporaneous records from training college
Arrange specialist psychological assessment
Research similar successful claims for precedent
Prepare detailed witness statement from client

Cases.Title: Multiple Deployment PTSD War Pension
Cases.Description: Warrant Officer with multiple Iraq and Afghanistan deployments seeking war pension for complex PTSD. Previous applications rejected due to insufficient medical evidence.
ToDos: Compile comprehensive deployment history and incident reports
Arrange assessment with military psychiatrist
Request witness statements from former colleagues
Challenge previous rejection decisions
Prepare detailed chronology of symptoms development

Cases.Title: Immigration Detention Challenge – Veteran Rights
Cases.Description: Polish-born RAF veteran challenging immigration detention and deportation order. Arguing breach of veterans' rights and family life under Article 8 ECHR.
ToDos: Apply for urgent bail from immigration detention
Gather evidence of military service and conduct
Prepare human rights challenge under Article 8
Contact media and veterans' charities for support
Research Armed Forces Covenant provisions on citizenship

Cases.Title: Mesothelioma Compensation – Asbestos Exposure
Cases.Description: Retired sergeant major diagnosed with mesothelioma from asbestos exposure during naval service. Pursuing compensation claim against Ministry of Defence.
ToDos: Document all naval postings and potential asbestos exposure
Instruct specialist asbestos solicitors for joint representation
Arrange fast-track medical evidence due to prognosis
Calculate compensation including family provision
Coordinate with other naval asbestos exposure cases

Cases.Title: Unfair Dismissal – PTSD Discrimination
Cases.Description: Former police constable dismissed from civilian security job after PTSD episode. Claiming unfair dismissal and disability discrimination at employment tribunal.
ToDos: Submit ET1 claim form before three-month deadline
Gather medical evidence of PTSD and reasonable adjustments needed
Request disciplinary hearing records and HR policies
Prepare schedule of loss including future earnings
Arrange workplace assessment for discrimination evidence

Cases.Title: Military Honours Appeal – Gallantry Recognition
Cases.Description: Retired colonel appealing decision not to award military honours for actions during Falklands conflict. Seeking recognition through Honours Forfeiture Committee.
ToDos: Research original nomination and decision-making process
Gather witness statements from surviving unit members
Review declassified operational reports and citations
Prepare submission to Honours Forfeiture Committee
Contact regimental association for support

Cases.Title: Naval Pension Sharing Dispute – Divorce Settlement
Cases.Description: Chief Petty Officer challenging ex-spouse's claim to naval pension in divorce proceedings. Arguing exceptional circumstances and service-related hardship.
ToDos: Review divorce settlement and pension sharing order
Calculate actual pension values and sharing implications
Argue exceptional circumstances for reduced sharing
Prepare evidence of service-related sacrifices and hardship
Research precedent cases in military pension disputes

Cases.Title: Medical Malpractice – Military Hospital Negligence
Cases.Description: Army lieutenant colonel pursuing clinical negligence claim for botched surgery at military hospital resulting in permanent disability and early medical discharge.
ToDos: Obtain complete medical records and surgical notes
Instruct independent medical expert for liability opinion
Calculate loss of military career and pension rights
Prepare Letter of Claim under Clinical Negligence Protocol
Arrange occupational therapy assessment for future care needs

Cases.Title: Veterans' Housing Possession Defence
Cases.Description: Army veteran facing mortgage possession proceedings following PTSD-related financial difficulties. Seeking time to sell and challenging lender's conduct.
ToDos: File defence to possession claim citing exceptional circumstances
Challenge lender's compliance with pre-action protocol
Apply for time order under Consumer Credit Act
Arrange independent property valuation for forced sale argument
Negotiate payment plan based on veteran's benefits and capacity

Cases.Title: Police Disciplinary Appeal – Misconduct Charges
Cases.Description: Retired police inspector appealing disciplinary findings and seeking restoration of reputation. Claims investigation was flawed and evidence was circumstantial.
ToDos: Review disciplinary investigation file and interview transcripts
Identify procedural breaches in investigation process
Prepare grounds of appeal to Police Appeals Tribunal
Gather character evidence and service record testimonials
Challenge reliability and admissibility of key evidence

Cases.Title: Armed Forces Covenant Education Support
Cases.Description: Army major's children denied school places despite Armed Forces Covenant provisions. Challenging local authority's failure to prioritize military families.
ToDos: Review school admission policies and covenant obligations
Gather evidence of frequent postings and impact on children
Challenge local authority decision through appeals process
Prepare judicial review application if necessary
Contact other military families with similar issues

Cases.Title: Police Injury Benefit Termination Challenge
Cases.Description: Former police constable challenging termination of injury benefit payments following medical review. Arguing condition has worsened rather than improved.
ToDos: Request all medical evidence relied upon by pension authority
Arrange independent medical examination and specialist reports
Review original injury award decision and medical board findings
Prepare detailed grounds of appeal with medical evidence
Calculate financial impact of benefit termination

Cases.Title: Naval Nuclear Test Compensation Claim
Cases.Description: Royal Navy veteran seeking compensation for radiation exposure during nuclear testing programs. Pursuing group litigation for health consequences and inadequate protection.
ToDos: Join existing group litigation against Ministry of Defence
Compile service records showing presence at nuclear tests
Obtain medical evidence linking health conditions to radiation
Research declassified documents on safety procedures
Coordinate with other nuclear test veterans and support groups

Cases.Title: Military Sexual Trauma Legal Support
Cases.Description: Army corporal pursuing criminal injuries compensation and civil claim for sexual assault during military service. Seeking justice and ongoing therapeutic support.
ToDos: Submit CICA application with specialist trauma solicitor support
Gather military police investigation records and witness statements
Arrange specialist psychological assessment and ongoing therapy
Prepare civil claim against Ministry of Defence for institutional failure
Coordinate with military sexual trauma support organizations

Cases.Title: Veterans' Mental Health Tribunal Support
Cases.Description: Former army sergeant appealing Mental Health Act detention. Arguing that PTSD symptoms are being misinterpreted and requiring specialist veteran mental health advocacy.
ToDos: Review mental health assessment and detention papers
Instruct independent psychiatric expert with military experience
Prepare grounds for tribunal appeal
Arrange legal aid and tribunal representation
